player_prompt.intro:
Mwena ukubomba Mastermind.
Ukutaka kupata code elo {code_length} tarakimu ndefu, kila tarakimu kutoka 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mu mbali yenu, mungasubmita makani yenu mu fomu ifi: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Baada ya kila makani, mungatasha maoni mu fomu ya vigwagwa vyakwe na vyakwe vya mpemba.
Gwagwa lya kwe linaonyesha tarakimu iliyo sahihi mu nafasi iliyo sahihi, wakati gwagwa lya mpemba linaonyesha tarakimu iliyo sahihi mu nafasi isiyosahihi.
Mwena {max_turns} zuba za kukani code.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tamwaswike no kutantika inambala mu filembo fyabuuta.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ifyalembwa fyonse fifwile ukuba fya namba ishili shonse.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Amanambala yonse yafwile ukuba pakati ka 1 na {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Mwalitala mwishiba {guess}. Mukwai esheni ukulolesha fimbi.

game_action.feedback: Mwasubmita [{guess}]. Maoni: {black_pegs} vigwagwa vyakwe, {white_pegs} vigwagwa vya mpemba.

outcome.win: Wacita uluse ku Mastermind, wapitiliza {black_pegs} kati ya {code_length} pegs kuwama.
outcome.turn_limit: Icipimo ca kuputulako capwa. Mwalibwene bwino amapesenti {percent} aya manambala.
